sample_unit: thyroid cancer surgical pathology reports (1008 question-answer pairs)

links.outcome: LLM extraction concordance with human reviewers on 12 questions across 84 reports
links.effect: LLM concordant with reviewers 1 and 2 at 89% (7%; 896/1008) and 89% (7.2%; 903/1008); reviewers concordant with each other at 99% (1%; 999/1008).
links.quote: The LLM was concordant with reviewers 1 and 2 at an overall average (SD) rate of 89% (7%; 896/1008 responses) and 89% (7.2%; 903/1008 responses).

unlisted_practices: Deploying open-source LLMs locally behind institutional firewalls to protect patient data

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a locally deployed open-source LLM for data extraction from surgical pathology reports compared to human reviewers.
